name: AI Title Generator
title: Free AI Title Generator for Blogs, Ads, and Social Posts
description: Generate clear, clickable title ideas from a topic, tone, and audience in seconds.
intro: Create SEO-friendly titles for articles, landing pages, email campaigns, and social posts. Tune the tone and count, then generate ready-to-edit ideas.

fields.label: Topic
fields.placeholder: Describe the article, product, or campaign
fields.help: Be specific about the subject and desired angle.

prompt.system: You are an expert SEO copywriter.
prompt.userTemplate: Generate {{count}} {{tone}} title ideas for this topic: {{topic}}. Return a numbered list.

steps: Enter your topic or content brief.
Choose a tone that matches your audience.
Generate titles and refine the strongest options.

faqs.question: Can these titles be used for SEO pages?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool is designed to create concise titles that can be reviewed and adapted for search intent.

faqs.question: Should I edit the generated titles?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the output as a strong draft, then align wording with your brand, keyword research, and SERP context.

name: AI Text Summarizer
title: Free AI Text Summarizer for Articles and Notes
description: Paste long text and get a concise summary with key points.
intro: Turn long passages into compact summaries for research, notes, content planning, and internal documentation.

fields.label: Text to summarize
fields.placeholder: Paste your article, transcript, or notes

prompt.system: You summarize text accurately and clearly.
prompt.userTemplate: Summarize the following text in {{style}} style: {{text}}

steps: Paste the text you want to condense.
Review the result and copy it into your workflow.

faqs.question: Is this useful for long articles?
faqs.answer: Yes. Longer inputs benefit from clearer summaries, especially when the source material has multiple sections.

faqs.question: Can I change the format?
faqs.answer: The admin can configure field options and prompt templates for each tool page.
